            maxLength = currentLength
        currentLength = 0
    elif ch == ')':
        insideParentheses = False
        previousWasLetter = False
        if currentLength > maxLength:
            maxLength = currentLength
        currentLength = 0

print(f"{maxLength} {underscoreCount}")
